row-subject.purpose: Subject line in the message list.

label.purpose: Compact uppercase list section and count labels.

metadata.purpose: Addresses, timestamps, and quiet secondary information.

extensions.platform: Linux desktop; native GPUI Kit window; no web or mobile breakpoint contract.

appearanceMeta.paletteSource: Selected Zeron theme variant in apps/megamail/src/theme.rs; frontmatter colors describe the default palette.

themeModel.variantSelection: Light and Dark variants are persisted independently; System follows the desktop appearance.
themeModel.accent: Theme default or user-selected accent preset.
themeModel.import: VS Code JSON/JSONC theme files and extension package.json manifests; imports normalize into the Zeron model. Native Zeron theme JSON is not imported.
themeModel.libraryActions: Remove imported families or reset preferences while retaining the library.

wallpaperControls.backgrounds: All effects and controls apply to built-in and custom backgrounds.
wallpaperControls.processing: Background processing into a cached static image; image changes crossfade over 240 ms.

paneSurfaces.contrastGuard: Opaque work panes exclude wallpaper. Address-derived correspondent colors are constrained against actual theme, selection, hover and avatar surfaces for small-text legibility.

appearanceMeta.renderingLimit: MegaMail does not use Zeron renderer-specific backdrop blur or per-primitive edge fades.

mailExperience.defaultScope: Unified Inbox, with independent bounded Inbox header pages per account.
mailExperience.partialFailures: Keep results from accounts that loaded and show a warning for accounts whose page failed.
mailExperience.messageIdentity: Scope IMAP UIDs by account and folder.
mailExperience.conversationGrouping: Group by message reference headers across folders and Sent; never group by subject alone. Related lookup is bounded and can report partial results.

relatedMessages.partialResults: Warn when related-message lookup is incomplete; do not promise every historical or future reply.

mailExperience.threadPresentation: Expandable replies in the list; chronological authored reader blocks with selected, newest and latest sent messages available to open independently. Full sender addresses and folder-role-based You · draft / You · sent labels distinguish authorship.
mailExperience.search: Direct accounts query the local SQLite cache within the selected folder or All local mail; body: covers downloaded, unencrypted bodies only. All local mail excludes Trash, Junk and Templates. Legacy adapters search loaded headers. No provider-global coverage is claimed.

bodyHandling.thunderbirdUnifiedQueries: Bounded headers only; fetch message bodies when selected.
bodyHandling.liveSelection: Retain only the selected message body in the live mailbox state.
bodyHandling.readerBodyCache: Up to 8 entries and 32 MiB total.

mailExperience.replyAll: Use the owning account; exclude the user’s own account addresses and aliases.
mailExperience.reader: Selectable sanitized native semantic HTML, with an isolated ephemeral WebKit helper preserving authored HTML typography, colors and table layout while blocking remote resources. Plain-text and selectable-text views remain available.
mailExperience.quoteHiding: Recognized quoted history can be collapsed and restored; original-format and native semantic views retain their distinct rendering policies.
mailExperience.sorting: Date, sender email, subject and unread, in either direction: direct-account folder cache sorting before paging; loaded-header sorting for legacy adapters. Unified lists merge bounded pages.
mailExperience.workStates: Needs reply, Waiting, Done and one-day Snoozed are saved on this device independently of provider flags. New inbound mail reopens Waiting/Done. Suggestions never claim saved work; loading, busy and save errors are explicit. Demo changes are session-only.
mailExperience.composition: Browsing retains the active composer with Resume draft. Plain text is the default; opt-in Markdown includes a formatted preview and recovered HTML is preserved. This is not WYSIWYG editing.
mailExperience.outgoingCards: Session-local provisional replies show actual send state and reconcile by exact account and Message-ID. Durable Outbox and draft recovery remain restart authority. Acceptance is not delivery; uncertain outcomes require review before retry.

components.name: Folder navigation row
components.description: Flat selected and hover states with a restrained 4px row corner and no surrounding card.

components.name: Selected message row
components.description: Compact message and conversation rows with 4px corners; reply children expand, and grouping uses reference headers rather than subject text.

components.name: Message search input
components.description: Direct accounts query the local SQLite cache within the selected folder or All local mail; body: covers downloaded, unencrypted bodies only. All local mail excludes Trash, Junk and Templates. Legacy adapters search loaded headers. No provider-global coverage is claimed.

components.name: Archive or restore button
components.description: Compact secondary action with a native icon, hover state, and visible keyboard focus.

components.name: Email reading pane
components.description: Opaque chronological reader with distinct neutral or quiet accent-tinted authored blocks, full sender addresses and explicit own-message labels; sanitized semantic and isolated original-format views block remote resources.

narrative.overview:
MegaMail carries Zeron’s calm surface hierarchy, compact controls, and careful text ladder into a native email workspace. The desktop layout is a 232px account/folder rail, a 332px message list, and an opaque reading pane. Rows are 78px high with 4px corners. Hairlines separate the work panes; individual messages use restrained authored blocks within the reader.

The app uses official GPUI Kit 0.7.1 and the complete standalone Zeron theme model copied from MIT-licensed source commit `0c4835d2b73aa632b7b4d626ee0826a25ec1c9b9`: 19 families and 30 built-in variants. System mode follows the desktop appearance; Light and Dark variant selections are independent. Accent and surface treatments can be overridden. The [preview captures](docs/preview/) show earlier release surfaces in fictional demo mode; comfort-work captures live under `.impeccable/review/`. Source is authoritative where a capture predates a correction.
keyCharacteristics: Opaque work panes with a quiet navigation shell, one message-list plane and distinct authored message blocks.
Dense but legible email rows, with sender, subject, and snippet in clear order.
Indigo reserved for focus and identity cues; neutral fills show hover and selection.
Opaque mail and task surfaces that keep wallpaper out of reading and interaction areas.

rules.name: The Role Remap Rule
rules.body: Keep semantic roles stable across modes and use each mode’s own value. Do not mechanically invert the dark palette.

rules.name: The Quiet Accent Rule
rules.body: Keep the selected accent to focus, unread, star and own-message identity cues. A quiet accent wash distinguishes authored outgoing blocks; neutral fills carry large selected and hovered areas.

rules.name: The Opaque Work Pane Rule
rules.body: Keep navigation, message-list, reader and task pane backgrounds fully opaque in every theme and surface preference. Wallpaper must not compete with mail text or controls.

rules.name: The Static Material Rule
rules.body: Apply wallpaper blur and treatments before caching. MegaMail does not implement Zeron’s renderer-specific backdrop blur or per-primitive edge fades.

dos: Do use the native palette values in the YAML as the source for text and tint roles; label Zeron source values separately.
Do keep the outer reading pane quiet and use authored blocks to distinguish individual messages.
Do distinguish hover from selection, and pair unread weight with its dot cue.
Do keep mail and task pane backgrounds fully opaque across appearance settings.
Do check small sender text against the actual theme and its selected, hover and avatar surfaces.
Do keep keyboard navigation, Kit focus treatment, accessible action labels, and Linux caption behavior intact.
Do distinguish live account state and operation results from sample-data visual fixtures.
Do keep motion tied to changing state and honor reduced-motion settings if transitions are added.
Do preserve Zeron source attribution and the license for every copied implementation or asset.
donts: Don't wrap every pane or message row in a card.
Don't use saturated accent as a large surface or rely on color alone for unread state or authorship.
Don't expose wallpaper through mail or task panes or imply a per-pixel contrast guarantee.
Don't imply web/mobile responsiveness or measured performance from this native desktop app.
Don't add idle decorative animation or copy Zeron icons without their license and attribution.
